name: Scent antenna
description: Tapered feeler rooted at the origin, curving up and forward (+x), tipped with a sensing nub. The hive reads the world with these first: a body's eyes, where it has them, are small and dark and unlit by day. Worn only by the expedition, and deliberately unlit, always: in this world a glow means emission, and nothing of yours emits. The hive's own feelers are drawn on each body, and only those light at night, at the tip (a `feeler_tip` part; docs/character-rig-guide.md §5.1) — this one never does, and carries no tip for that reason.

dead.description: A survivor's antenna — intact, but nothing on the air to read.
